tool_args.rationale: The authorized matched subtree and signatures specify the reduced two-layer siphon base with an open local square-root branch. The five observations span a useful range of u_now and s_grad and are explicitly described as identifying the three parameters, so the lowest-cost action is a numerical least-squares fit rather than another measurement.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied subtree guidance says the five pilot rows identify the three-parameter base-plus-square-root branch; the feature span is not flagged as collinear.
Temporal trajectory data is not indicated as necessary for this reduced-slow-ODE snapshot model at H=0.6.
Nuisance auxiliary measurements are explicitly irrelevant to the identified subtree.
All supplied s_grad values are at or below 2.2, below the 2.36 supercritical probe threshold; no avalanche term is motivated.
Pilot signature and authorized subtree guidance support the two-layer siphon base rather than a high-u downturn mechanism.
